metadata.description: Presentation styles for reports built on the IBCS® notation — IBCS (the only IBCS-compliant one), Showcase, Soft, Graphic, Annual, Wallboard, Contrast and Terminal — in light and dark, with the same numbers and one page layout in every style.

plugins.name: report-styles
plugins.description: Eight report styles in light and dark — IBCS (the only IBCS-compliant one) plus seven that borrow its notation: a style and theme switch, one shared page layout, a reconcile test, tokens with contrast guardrails, React components, Power BI themes, Deneb overrides and a playground.
